application.releaseStatus: Unreleased development; separate draft PR stacked on A08. Historical releases unchanged.

scope: Two independent synthetic walkthroughs with explicit manual control settings; activity.json is a handout authoring configuration, not an application scenario format.
modelChecks: Aa x Aa: genotype probabilities 1/4 AA, 1/2 Aa, 1/4 aa; complete-dominance phenotype probabilities 3/4 A_ and 1/4 aa.
AaBb x AaBb: four gametes per parent with probability 1/4; complete-dominance phenotype probabilities 9/16, 3/16, 3/16, 1/16.
AaBb genotype has probability 1/4, combining four cells with probability 1/16 each.
Seeds reproduce trials; all offspring enter counts, with at most 64 individual genotypes displayed. Expected counts can be fractional and finite trials can differ from expected ratios.

handout.renderer: Poppler pdftoppm, both final pages inspected at 1350-pixel height
handout.htmlChecks: Standalone Edge rendering at 390 x 844 has no page overflow, network requests or exceptions; native browser printing also yields exactly two A4 pages.

actualApplicationChecks: delayed tree-demo cancellation on module switch

originalMaterials: The existing three ZIP packs, three PDFs, tree sources and two scenario JSON files are unchanged. Existing scenario verification checks their recorded hashes.
limits: No measured organism/genotype data; no linkage, sex linkage, mutation, selection, penetrance variation, epistasis or environmental effects. No saved inheritance scenarios, learner progress, tree project, pedigree inference, worksheet-export feature or ongoing lesson programme.
